description: Hard benign sentences: ordinary paper, benchmark or documentation text that shares vocabulary with injection payloads (instructions, system prompt, ignore, override, reviewer, perfect, tool names). The sanitiser must leave every one of them untouched. In addition the harness measures false positives on every sentence of the PDF corpus in data/papers/.
